$comment: Advisories a dependency carries with no patched version to move to. Each names its reason and the date it is looked at again; an expired one fails lint:dependency-advisories until it is fixed or renewed.

exceptions.reason: No version of braces is patched (3.0.3 is the latest and is affected). It reaches the tree through micromatch in build and test tooling, where every pattern is the repository's own.
